title: service-knowledge: os knowledge rebuild and status give the right answer behind a load balancer
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37099 (PR #37439, contract record 7184443506 finding S2, seat L1 7184456563), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under topic #37000, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p3 (suggested; triage seat offline) · reach: operators running `os knowledge` against a multi-node deployment · evidence: read from the PR #37439 code by the contract reviewer, not run.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：多节点部署时，运维用命令行重建知识源或查看状态，要拿到正确结果，而不是看运气打到哪个节点。
- 谁受益：多节点部署的运维和自动化脚本。
- 不做会怎样：重建其实在跑、最后也成功了，命令行却可能报失败，脚本会当成故障处理。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

As of PR #37439 (#37099), the build record (progress and last result, which card #37099 item 3 asks the operator entry to read) lives in memory on the node that ran the build and is gone on restart. Behind a load balancer, `os knowledge status` reaches the building node only by chance, and `os knowledge rebuild` exits 1 as soon as a poll lands on another node, although the build continues and may succeed.

## Acceptance

One of, chosen in the PR with its reason:
- the build record is shared across nodes (cluster or store backed), or
- the CLI falls back to the index state read from the store, which is the same on every node (`due` turning `current` means done), and only reports failure on a recorded failure.

A test drives a poll that lands on a node without the record and asserts the command does not exit 1 while the build is still running or after it succeeded.
